name: llms.txt generator
tagline: Read a public sitemap and write an llms.txt index, plus an optional llms-full.txt.
description: Generate a spec-compliant llms.txt and an optional llms-full.txt from a public sitemap, with an editable preview.

name: AI SEO checker
tagline: Score crawler access, llms.txt, structured data, and the on-page signals AI search uses.
description: Score a public URL for AI crawlers, llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, metadata, headings, and answer-first content.

name: OG image generator
tagline: Compose a 1200×630 card, watch it update, then download the PNG or copy the Next.js file.
description: Design a 1200×630 Open Graph image in the browser. Choose a template, set type and colors, download a PNG, or copy a Next.js opengraph-image.tsx file.

name: JWT decoder
tagline: Paste a JSON Web Token, read the claims, and verify the signature in the browser.
description: Decode a JWT and verify HS, RS, PS, ES, and EdDSA signatures in the browser. The token and keys are not uploaded.

name: robots.txt checker
tagline: Read allow and disallow rules, sitemap links, and the mistakes that make a robots.txt file lie.
description: Fetch a public robots.txt, list Allow and Disallow rules and sitemap links, and flag common mistakes. Private addresses are blocked.

name: Meta tags inspector
tagline: Read title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter, and JSON-LD types from one public URL.
description: Inspect a public page for title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD types. A checklist marks what social previews and AI search need.

name: JSON-LD schema generator
tagline: Fill a form, get valid schema.org JSON-LD for Article, FAQ, Product, Organization, and more.
description: Free JSON-LD schema markup generator. Build Article, BlogPosting, FAQPage, HowTo, Product, Organization, Person, LocalBusiness, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication, WebSite, and Event schema, then copy the script tag or a Next.js component.

name: AI token counter
tagline: Count tokens and estimate the API cost of a prompt for GPT, Claude, and Gemini models.
description: Free LLM token counter and API cost calculator. Paste text to count tokens with OpenAI's tokenizers and estimate input and output cost across GPT, Claude, Gemini, and other models.

name: Cron expression builder
tagline: Build or paste a cron schedule, read it in plain English, and see the next run times.
description: Free cron expression generator and explainer. Build a schedule visually or paste one to translate it into plain English, validate it, and preview the next 10 run times in any timezone. Supports standard 5-field cron, seconds, Quartz, and macros.

name: Next.js Dockerfile generator
tagline: Generate a production multi-stage Dockerfile for Next.js, plus .dockerignore and compose.
description: Free Next.js Dockerfile generator. Pick your package manager, Node version, standalone output, Prisma, and healthcheck, and get a small multi-stage Dockerfile with .dockerignore, docker-compose.yml, and next.config settings.

name: JSON formatter
tagline: Pretty-print, minify, and validate JSON, with the exact line and column when it fails.
description: Free JSON formatter and JSON validator that runs in the browser. Choose an indent of 2, 4, or a tab, sort object keys, minify, and read a tree of the value. Invalid JSON reports the line, the column, and the line of source.

name: JSON YAML converter
tagline: Convert JSON, YAML, TOML, and XML in the browser, and keep the line number when a document fails.
description: Free converter for JSON to YAML, YAML to JSON, TOML, and XML to JSON. The source format can be detected automatically. Errors include a line and column. Conversion stays in the browser.

name: CSV JSON converter
tagline: Convert CSV to JSON and JSON back to CSV, with a delimiter and a header row you choose.
description: Free CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV converter. Pick a comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe, or let the first row decide. Keep or drop the header, infer booleans and numbers, and flatten nested JSON into dotted columns. It runs in the browser.

name: Diff checker
tagline: Compare two texts side by side or inline, and download a unified patch.
description: Free diff checker for text and JSON. Compare by line, word, or character, ignore whitespace, or diff JSON so key order does not matter. The result is a side-by-side view, an inline view, and a unified patch. It runs in the browser.

name: Base64 codec
tagline: Encode and decode Base64 for text or a file, including the URL-safe alphabet.
description: Free Base64 encode and Base64 decode tool for text and files. Turn on URL-safe output, wrap a file as a data URI, or decode a data URI back to text or a download. The file never leaves the browser.

name: Image format converter
tagline: Convert HEIC, WebP, PNG, JPG, and AVIF in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
description: Free image format converter for HEIC to JPG, WebP to PNG, PNG to JPG, and AVIF. Drop a batch, pick a target, and download the files or a ZIP. Decoding and encoding run on this device, so the pictures never leave the browser.

name: Image compressor
tagline: Shrink JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF in the browser, with the real before and after size.
description: Free image compressor. Set a quality level, optionally cap the long edge, and compress a batch of JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF files. You see the size before and after, the savings, and you can download a ZIP. The work stays on this device.

name: Image resizer
tagline: Resize by pixels or percent, with the aspect ratio locked and a batch ZIP.
description: Free image resizer. Set a width, a height, or a percent, lock the aspect ratio, and fit a batch with contain, cover, or stretch. Presets cover Instagram, Stories, Open Graph, and HD. Resizing runs in the browser, so the files stay on the device.

name: Color converter
tagline: Turn any color into HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, and CMYK, and check the contrast ratio.
description: Free color converter and contrast checker. Paste HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, CMYK, or a CSS color name and read every format back. The contrast ratio uses WCAG 2, with AA and AAA flags for normal and large text, plus the nearest Tailwind token.

name: Unix timestamp converter
tagline: Turn epoch seconds or milliseconds into a date, and a date in any time zone back into epoch time.
description: Free epoch converter for unix timestamps. Switch between seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, and nanoseconds, read ISO-8601 and RFC 2822 dates, and convert both ways across IANA time zones. Runs in the browser.

name: Date difference calculator
tagline: Count the days, weeks, and business days between two dates.
description: Free date calculator for the exact days between two dates. See the calendar span, elapsed time, weeks, and business days with weekends and your own holiday list excluded. Runs in the browser.

name: Hash generator
tagline: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 checksums for text or a file, with HMAC.
description: Free SHA-256 and MD5 hash generator. Checksum text or a file with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512, copy hex or base64, compare an expected digest, and compute HMAC. The bytes stay in the browser.

name: UUID generator
tagline: Generate UUID v4 or v7 in bulk, and read the time stored in a v7 id.
description: Free UUID and GUID generator for version 4 and version 7. Create one id or a bulk list from cryptographic randomness, then inspect a UUID to see its version, variant, and v7 timestamp.

name: URL encoder and parser
tagline: Encode or decode a URL, then break the query string into parameters.
description: Free URL encoder and decoder. Percent-encode a component or a whole URL, decode it again, and parse a URL into its host, path, and query parameters. Edit the query and copy the rebuilt URL. Runs in the browser.

name: Password generator
tagline: Cryptographic passwords and passphrases, with an entropy strength meter.
description: Free strong password generator. Build a password with crypto.getRandomValues, choose the length and character sets, skip ambiguous characters, or make a passphrase. The strength meter shows the entropy in bits.

name: Chmod calculator
tagline: Turn a permission grid into octal and symbolic chmod, and back.
description: Free chmod calculator. Check read, write, and execute for owner, group, and others, including setuid, setgid, and the sticky bit. See the octal mode, the symbolic mode, and the chmod command.

name: Merge PDF
tagline: Combine PDFs in the browser. Reorder them, keep a page range from each file, and download one document.
description: Free PDF merger. Combine PDFs in the browser, drag them into order, and keep a page range such as 1-3,5 from each file. The merge runs on this device. The files are not uploaded.

name: Split PDF
tagline: Extract a page range, or split a PDF into single pages or chunks, then download a PDF or a ZIP.
description: Free split PDF tool. Extract pages with a range such as 1-3,5, save every page as its own PDF, or split every N pages. The work runs in the browser and the file is not uploaded. Several files download as a ZIP.

name: Compress PDF
tagline: Shrink a PDF in the browser. Pick a preset or a target size and compare the file before and after.
description: Free PDF compressor. Shrink a PDF for an upload limit without sending it anywhere. Light, medium, and strong presets recompress embedded images and clear document info. Text stays selectable. A target of 100 KB, 200 KB, or 500 KB tries harder until the file fits or the smallest result is reached.

name: Image to PDF
tagline: Turn JPG, PNG, and WebP images into one PDF. Set the page size, orientation, margin, and order.
description: Free JPG to PDF and image to PDF converter. Drop JPG, PNG, or WebP pictures, put them in order, and choose A4, Letter, or a page that fits the picture. Portrait, landscape, or automatic orientation, with a margin. The PDF is built in the browser and the images are not uploaded.

name: QR code generator
tagline: Make a static QR code for text, a URL, Wi-Fi, or a vCard. Set the colors and error correction, then download SVG or PNG.
description: Free QR code generator for a URL, plain text, a Wi-Fi network, or a vCard. Pick the colors and the error-correction level, then download SVG and PNG. The code is static: it does not track scans, and it is drawn in this browser.
